Behavior complement is (X times Y) minus R. Specifically outputs violating Deleted vertices cannot belong to any minimum-degree-k induced subgraph. For live vertices degree equals count of live neighbors; survivor set is maximal. are excluded; a valid-input Err or a wrong successful witness is excluded.
